title: The Spy
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (public domain). Wikimedia Commons: The Spy MET DT228197.jpg
caption: Caught as a spy. He won't beg. #arthistory #history #painting #war #art
_verify: 'He won't beg': reading of his upright, defiant stance; the painting's story is not documented in detail.
Franco-Prussian War (1870-71); German officers interrogating a French civilian (Met description) — check.
The objects on the ground read as his searched belongings: interpretation.

slides.headline: Caught as a spy. He won't *beg*.
France, the war with Prussia. Officers rest at a village *inn*.
Soldiers bring in a man in a blue *shirt*.
Two soldiers grip his shoulders. He doesn't *fight*.
At the table, the officers look up from their *drinks*.
One officer stares at him. A spy? They need *proof*.
On the ground lie his things, already *searched*.
Above, a woman watches from the *window*.
A hussar on horseback blocks the *road*.
Behind them, soldiers climb the stairs as if nothing *happened*.
The quiet village church watches it all *happen*.
Spy or innocent? What would *you* decide?
